scope: Quake II deathmatch; additional reference study after Switchback
methods: Verify current BSP bytes and local readme/metadata bytes against recorded SHA-256.
Inspect fresh top-down upward-world-surface plans, all heights and three dominant height slices, plus embedded gameplay anchors.
Read original author notes and historical review notes where available.
Preserve measurements, spatial interpretations, historical opinions and untested hypotheses as separate evidence types.

measured: Two Combat Armors share origin z=-176, separated by 1579.9746833414767 units in Euclidean space.
Mega origin z=48; rocket launcher origin z=-272.
observations.plan_interpretation: Unequal plan extensions and partial routes separate lateral destination choices from the choice to gain elevation.
observations.hypothesis: Separate lateral resource destinations from vertical commitments; do not put every reward on one upper circuit.
observations.historical_evidence: Author readme describes a duel map and prohibits using the level as the base of additional levels.

measured: Rocket launcher and railgun origins z=-256.
Combat Armor, super shotgun and hyperblaster origins z=-32.
Jacket Armor and grenade launcher origins z=-176.
observations.plan_interpretation: Upper and lower route footprints differ; an intermediate equipment route exists between their dominant item heights.
observations.hypothesis: Place useful weapons and recovery resources below upper control; test whether the intermediate return makes control contestable.
observations.historical_evidence: Archived player reports use the recorded alias kamq2dm3, praise fast weapon/armor contests, but disagree over size and health scarcity. Settings and tested BSP revision are unknown.

measured: Dominant upward surface heights z=0 and z=192; four occupied 128-unit combat-anchor bands.
observations.plan_interpretation: Repeated octagonal rooms have upper and lower routes; the upper grenade position is near the lower chaingun junction.
observations.hypothesis: Shared architectural motifs may aid learning when their route roles differ; local overlooks need a useful lower destination and counterplay.
observations.historical_evidence: Author describes three two-level octagonal rooms, three elevators, one stair route and grenade fire through a hole over the chaingun intersection.
observations.counterexample: Repeated forms and some visible spawn pairs do not alone establish bad gameplay.

measured: Rocket origin z=-44, railgun and chaingun origins z=88, grenade launcher origin z=152, Combat Armor origin z=216.
Six embedded teleporter links; no classified movers.
observations.plan_interpretation: Unequal spaces and changing widths step through local elevations rather than form a complete repeated floor.
observations.hypothesis: Make a route sequence recognizable through local spatial identity and destination cues within a common theme.
observations.historical_evidence: The pack author credits John Hughes for Paranoia and declares shared theme plus custom sounds and textures; rendered cue effectiveness is untested.

proposed_rules.principle: Give alternative routes different approach, resource or exposure roles.
proposed_rules.mechanism: Players can rotate or retreat without meeting the same threat at the same shared choke.
proposed_rules.generator_action: Name two contests and a recovery destination before drawing rooms; audit shared physical approaches to each alternative.
proposed_rules.counterexample: A second route may be longer yet tactically useful; a larger graph cycle count does not prove useful alternatives.

ablation.change_only: Close one outer bypass while preserving items and remaining geometry.

proposed_rules.principle: Require every added floor to supply a destination, approach, overlook with counterplay, or return route.
proposed_rules.mechanism: Added height changes decisions without repeating the entire floor plan.
proposed_rules.generator_action: Annotate each platform purpose and both ascent/descent; omit unused global third floors.
proposed_rules.counterexample: Coarse 128-unit bands are not gameplay floors; a repeated balcony may still provide a useful return.

ablation.change_only: Close the local third-floor return doorway, retaining platform and item.

proposed_rules.principle: Make upper control relinquish or expose access to some weapon, armor or recovery resource.
proposed_rules.mechanism: Lower positions retain useful destinations and a possible route back into contention.
proposed_rules.generator_action: Place one strong weapon or useful recovery destination below an upper contest and verify reachability from disadvantaged spawns.
proposed_rules.counterexample: A low resource visible from the dominant position may reinforce its control instead of countering it.

ablation.change_only: Move one strong weapon between validated upper/lower sockets.

proposed_rules.principle: Give decisions recognizable spatial cues before texture variation.
proposed_rules.mechanism: Local silhouettes and destination cues let players learn return journeys while retaining tactical occlusion.
proposed_rules.generator_action: Vary opening direction, width and ceiling profile within one coherent theme; use landmarks visible at decision points.
proposed_rules.counterexample: Maximum visibility can aid orientation while exposing too many routes to one controlling position.

ablation.change_only: Change one junction silhouette accent or one material/light cue with geometry otherwise fixed.
measure: ability to retrace without a map

proposed_rules.principle: Shorten uninteresting travel while keeping contrasting encounter spaces and recovery opportunities.
proposed_rules.mechanism: Compactness creates more encounters only when circulation and recovery support the intended load.
proposed_rules.generator_action: Retain a wider lateral combat space alongside a close route; test low and high player loads separately.
proposed_rules.counterexample: Historical Reclamation reviewers disagreed about whether its compactness and sparse health were desirable.

ablation.change_only: Keep the map fixed and vary only player load in separate sessions.

promotion_policy: No new rule promoted to validated. Require a documented mechanism, counterexample, paired procedural ablation and repeated runtime/human evidence across different layouts. Keep generated examples out of the reference calibration profile.
limitations: All selected AAS files have zero reachability records and unverified source BSP association. Floor surfaces, anchor bins and entity targets cannot prove traversability.
Floor diagrams include inaccessible trim and omit entity submodel geometry; selected height slices may hide routes.
Static world LOS and Euclidean distances are descriptive proxies, not spawn safety or traversal times.
Actual material, lighting, sound and landmark readability was not tested in engine.
Historical Reclamation reviews use its recorded alias, but lack settings and exact tested-BSP provenance.

The current core includes same-node XY distance and cross-node endpoint approaches; Manhattan/node-center cost remains a heuristic rather than elapsed engine traversal time. Historical artifacts retain the earlier timing estimates.

evidence_issues.action: Preserve archive and author labels separately; verify revision/mode/load before using as training or playtest labels. Existing profile unchanged.
